profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of 
$2.6 trillion and operations worldwide.
The Firm is a leader in investment banking, financial 
services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction 
processing, and asset management. A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, 
JPMorgan Chase & Co. serves mil
lions of consumers in the United States and many of the 
world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under its J.P. Morgan 
and Chase brands. Information about JPMorgan Chase & Co. is available at 
www.jpmorganchase.com

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Java - Disbursements                  6/2019 – Present
•	Responsibilities include full SDLC support of a check reconciliation application.
o	Review and analyze functionality of the application running as Java on the mainframe using WebSphere Application Server.
o	Translate the backend functionality into a cloud based application using Java 11 , Spring Boot, and using Hibernate JDBC to connect to z/OS DB2 database.
o	Build automated test cases using Spock and Groovy.
o	Build and deploy the application to the internal cloud.
Skills used: Java 11, Spring Boot, Groovy, Spock, SQL, DB2, File-Aid, Bitbucket, Rest API, IntelliJ

Senior Software Engineer, Mainframe - Disbursements                  2/2016 – 6/2019			
•	Responsibilities include full SDLC support of 13 disbursements and insurance applications.in an Agile framework. 
	Review and analyze functional requirements. 
	Design technical solution and create detailed technical specifications and technical task plan. 
	Perform complex coding and testing activities.
	Package and distribute software changes to client.
	Tier 3 production support.
Skills used: COBOL, CICS, VSAM, DB2, BMS Maps, SQL, Writing Technical Specifications, File-Aid, Endevor, Changeman, Xpeditor, CA7, Zeke job scheduler.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities include full life-cycle support of the Bankway International application. This application consists of  a 3 Tier architecture using a proprietary Browser front end and communicates with the mainframe using MQ to access the Tier 2
business logic and Tier 3 file I/O which uses COBOL, CICS, and VSAM. Browser front end uses SQL tables to maintain data being communicated between the tiers.

Skills used: COBOL, CICS, VSAM, BMS Maps, SQL, Writing Technical Specifications File Manager, Viasoft Smarttest

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities include full life-cycle support of modifications to AFS Commercial Loan System in the areas of AFS 8.3 upgrade, bank acquisition conversions, interfaces, booking, profitability reporting, and others. Designed and supervised development of a customized interface from AFS Commercial Loans to an in-house PC based data entry and document tracking system.  
  Responsibilities include full life-cycle support of modifications to a Real Estate loan tracking system (RealTrac) written in FOXPRO utilizing a SQL Server database. This application interfaces with the AFS Commercial Loan System.

Skills used: COBOL, CICS, VSAM, BMS Maps, DB2, SQL, FOXPRO, Writing Technical Specifications, File-Aid, JCL, CA-7, Viasoft Smarttest, RACF, Endevor, Changeman
